$comment: Machine-readable project state. Any new session reads this first, then verifies it against GitHub before trusting it. Written at the end of each ticket, so a stale entry means a session ended mid-ticket — check the branch and CI rather than the status field.
current_phase: WAVE 1 en cours sur claude/sanitube-autonomous-v1-5pycx0 : AUDIT-001 puis USR-001, CFG-006, PROD-002, STO-005, SYS-001 dans cet ordre. OWNER est la racine, decidee par l'operateur : le dernier OWNER ne peut jamais etre retire, et seul un OWNER gere les OWNER, les secrets et les identifiants fournisseur. UPL-005 en revue : l'upload relaye etait casse en production depuis que app.blade.php ne publiait plus la meta csrf-token, et les trois ecrans qui signent leurs propres requetes (import, upload unitaire, test de connexion des reglages) mouraient en 419 avant tout controleur, en rapportant un message generique. Le jeton est publie, la lecture d'un refus tient compte du statut, et le contrat mise en page vers JavaScript est desormais teste avec VerifyCsrfToken ACTIF. Ce ticket touche a la securite CSRF : REVIEW_REQUIRED, ne pas fusionner avant verdict. NOTE : DOC-007 (PR 159) etait fusionne sur main alors que ce fichier disait encore DOC-006 — verifie contre l'API cette session. Mission centre de configuration terminee cote interne : CFG-001 a CFG-005, TRASH-001, DUP-001, OPS-002, UPL-004, DOC-006, DOC-007 fusionnes. SANITUBE_PRODUCTION_READY = oui pour le code, non comme deploiement en fonctionnement — et UPL-005 est la preuve que les deux ne sont pas la meme chose. R2_CODE_READY=YES, R2_CONFIGURED=NO, R2_CONNECTIVITY_VERIFIED=NO. Quatre decisions attendent l'operateur : purge de la corbeille, chiffrement des sauvegardes au repos, actions groupees sur les doublons, planification du balayage des doublons. Le detail est docs/final-report.md section 13.
last_completed_ticket: AUDIT-001 — audit de parite dashboard, sur cette branche. DOC-007 est le dernier fusionne sur main. UPL-005 est ouvert et en revue.
default_branch: main — confirmed by API this session. The EXTERNAL_ADMIN_ACTION_REQUIRED blocker is cleared.

UI-001.note: Design system, shell, one showcase screen. Review corrections C1-C4 applied: shared useModalSurface (focus trap, Escape, focus restore, counted scroll lock, inert background) for both AppModal and the mobile drawer; router.on unsubscribe on unmount; Vitest + jsdom component suite wired into the frontend CI job.
UI-001.review: CORRECTIONS REQUIRED (C1-C4) -> applied -> authorised to merge

INS-001.note: php artisan sanitube:install — seven idempotent stages in the Installer module slot reserved since ARCH-001. The service is the installer so INS-002 can reuse it. Never overwrites .env, never replaces APP_KEY, always backs up at 0600, never takes a password as an option. Three defects found while building: preflight would have refused every first install on the scheduler capability, --skip-owner always exited non-zero, and .gitignore did not cover .env.backup-*.

UI-002.note: Dashboard on real data. C1: operational probing moved out of the request cycle into sanitube:health:refresh + OperationalHealthStore; the dashboard reads FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN and blanks every verdict when stale.

UI-004.note: Four read-only ingestion screens. The candidate detail keeps four kinds of evidence apart: measured, claimed, noticed, decided. No object key, no disk, no bucket, and neither the storage driver's nor the analyser's failure message. Counts for a page come from one grouped query, asserted by a query count. Six regressions injected, every one turned a test red.

UI-005.note: Five read-only studio screens. Three provider states kept distinct — not configured is not a problem. Commercial rights UNKNOWN counted on the front page because nothing ever infers it away. No provider job id and no audio reference reach the browser; has_audio replaces the reference. Five regressions injected, every one turned a test red.

SYS-001.note: Operations and jobs screens behind can.role:administer. A GET probes nothing — proved by forgetting the snapshot, loading the page, and asserting it is still absent. No job payload and no stack trace reaches the browser; only the exception's first line, truncated. Unknown is not zero: an installation on Redis has no jobs table and the counts read null.

INS-002.note: Web installer over the SAME InstallationService. Filesystem token, two guards, permanent lock. Found that SESSION_DRIVER=database makes the install page unable to hold a CSRF token before migrations, and that db_password was being flashed into the session by Laravel validation redirects.

UI-003a.note: Tracks index + detail. C1 active identifiers only (scoped at the read-model boundary, not a global scope). C2 invalid filters answer 422 and the form renders canonical values. C3 search documentation corrected to contains-search. C4 malformed cursor refused deterministically instead of 500.
UI-003a.review: CORRECTIONS REQUIRED (C1-C4) -> applied -> authorised to merge

UI-003b.note: Artists index + detail. C1 tracks_shown reports what was returned, not the cap. C2 the capped selection is ordered by track title then track uuid, so it is stable across loads and across the four engines. C3 the truncation test was strengthened, which caught a fixture of mine that made the determinism assertion pass against a deliberately broken ordering.

UI-003c.note: Contributors + Compositions index and detail. Credit shares travel as credited_share and a test asserts neither a bare `share` key nor the words ownership/royalty/entitlement appear in any payload — the rights domain does not exist yet. Legal name and display name kept as separate labelled facts. CursorShape extracted and shared by four lists.

UI-003d.review_required_because: Introduces the capability to hand out time-limited access to stored objects including masters.
UI-003d.note: Assets + signed preview. C1 was a real defect: default provider resolved instead of the one the asset records. Both call sites now use provider($asset->disk), no fallback. C2 60/min per-user mint budget. C3 no-store on success and refusal alike.
UI-003d.corrections: C1 storage provenance, C2 mint throttle, C3 uncacheable credential — applied

BULK-001a.note: Batch progress derived from the items, never stored beside them. One grouped count per batch, asserted. No percentage and no ETA — both would be invented.

BULK-001b.note: CSV manifest import + sanitube:import. A manifest is evidence, never authority: after importing 900 files naming 900 ISRCs, tracks and external_identifiers are both still empty. A bad row is refused with its line number; a bad file is fatal. An ISRC already active on another track holds the candidate NEEDS_REVIEW. Eight regressions injected, every one turned a test red.

UI-004b.note: Promote, decline, correct the title — each calling the CAT-001 service that owns it, none writing a status. can.role:catalogue on the route; a MEMBER may read the queue and decide nothing in it. The actions block in the payload is presentation only, proved by posting past a hidden button. The reviewer is now recorded, where the API's call leaves it null. Six regressions injected, every one turned a test red.

BULK-001c.note: Identity is already content-based and all four cases pass; the forbidden key shortcut is absent. What remains is an amplification factor of 2, now asserted as a baseline. Removing the second copy contradicts an AST-001 invariant and a merged assertion, so ADR-0015 records three options and recommends one rather than changing the storage core.

SYS-001b.note: Failed-job retry and record removal behind can.role:administer. Retryability is declared by the job through the SafelyRetryable marker — opt in, never opt out — so the one operation that must never happen twice (ImportGenerationResultJob, SubmitMusicGenerationJob) is never offered a retry button. No payload or stack trace ever leaves QueueQuery.

UI-005b.note: Create a campaign, start a generation, cancel one, select a result. Selecting never creates a Track — proved by mutation. Two behaviours extracted from API controllers into services because a second controller copy is the one that drifts; all 49 pre-existing generation tests passed unmodified after the move.

ROY-001.reason: Royalty engine. Removed from V1 by the scope correction: SaniTube performs no financial calculation.

RIGHTS-001.reason: Rights management. Removed from V1 in its financial form. Credit and ownership metadata needed for distribution stays, and is delivered as catalogue metadata under the REL and CAT tickets.

PUB-001.reason: Publishing administration. Its purpose is collection and distribution of publishing income, which the scope correction removes from V1. Composition and writer metadata already exists in CAT-002 and stays.

REL-002.note: Validation answers in ReleaseValidationIssue codes rather than English. Closed the bug where SubmitDelivery decided unreachability by substring-matching a message.

SET-002.note: Settings write path. Allowlist of thirteen variables; APP_KEY, APP_DEBUG and DB_* deliberately absent. Blank never clears. One write over a backup, config cache rebuilt or the file restored. Not REVIEW_REQUIRED: no new secrets architecture, it writes through the installer EnvironmentFile.

E2E-001.note: The V1 definition of done as a walk. Found and fixed a restore that could not restore (alphabetical dump order broke foreign keys) and found the catalogue write gap CAT-002 closes.

CAT-002.note: Track credits and readiness behind can.role:catalogue. Also fixed the stale-cache defect: DeploymentTest left the application cached, which can make a removed authorization guard look enforced.

ING-002.note: Starting an import from the interface. Gave IngestionException a reason distinct from its persisted failure code, refused an ambiguous folder+list selection that used to drop the list silently, and stopped the stylesheet being built from the compiled-view cache.

DIST-001-H1.note: Unknown submission outcome, merged after the three approved corrections: findSubmission() moved to a SupportsSubmissionLookup capability, external references carry provenance (PROVIDER_RESPONSE/PROVIDER_LOOKUP/MANUAL_OPERATOR), and decided_by carries a RESTRICT foreign key.

PROD-001.notes: ProductionPlan and the autonomy ladder. AUTONOMOUS_RELEASE locked in code.

AUTH-002.note: Password reset over Laravel's broker. The request never says whether an address is known — same status, same Location, same empty error bag — and a deactivated account cannot reset its way back in, including one deactivated after the link was sent. Reset rotates remember_token and logs out other devices.

AUDIT-001.note: L'ecart entre ce que le backend sait faire et ce qu'un operateur peut demander depuis l'interface. 74 capacites, 46 avec une UI, 28 sans. 88 des 139 variables SANITUBE_* n'ont aucun ecran, 19 des 35 commandes artisan exigent un shell. Cinq lacunes P0. docs/dashboard-parity-audit.md.

A11Y-001.note: 61 of 65 form fields rendered a label pointing at nothing. FormField now provides its wiring and the controls inject it; all call sites fixed without editing one. A second bug found while fixing it: Vue casts absent Boolean props to false, so the nullish coalescing never fell through and aria-invalid would have been absent everywhere.

MED-003.note: Shipped ordering by ABS(unsigned - ?), which aborts on MySQL and MariaDB and only works on SQLite. Caught by the engine matrix and fixed before merge; see ADR-0017.

DEDUP-001.note: Fingerprint comparison with alignment search; three duplicate levels; findings PROPOSED only. Chromaprint switched to raw output (VERSION 2). ADR-0016, ADR-0017.

DEDUP-002.note: DecideDuplicate and TrashAsset. Logical trash as three nullable columns, never a status and never a deletion. Permanent deletion deliberately not implemented.

DEDUP-003.note: The duplicate queue. Deciding and trashing stay separate routes. Fixed a defective leak assertion and a payload widening AssetIndexQuery's no-filename boundary.

TRN-001.note: Transcription contract, transcripts + transcript_segments, TranscribeAsset. A transcript is SUGGESTED and reaches nothing in the catalogue. No vendor adapter ships — deliberate.

OPS-002.note: L'arret global existait, fonctionnait, et n'etait rapporte nulle part : une installation mise en pause la veille ressemblait a une installation saine. L'ecran des operations le dit desormais en premier, et POST /system/operations/pause|resume rend le contretemps atteignable sans SSH. Raison = vocabulaire ferme ; une raison absente fonctionne quand meme.

PIPE-001.note: Found that nothing in the application called EvaluateAssetDuplicates, FingerprintAsset or TranscribeAsset — four merged tickets whose output would have been permanently empty. Wires fingerprinting and evaluation via events, adds the backfill command behind the OPS-002 gates. Transcription stays disconnected until an adapter ships.

TRN-002.notes: OpenAI /audio/transcriptions adapter. Provider certification CONFIGURED_UNCERTIFIED: no real credential has ever been used from this installation. Mutation table amended by TRN-003 after a harness defect was found.

TRN-003.notes: Transcription production wiring. Automatic transcription is OFF by default; it is the only enrichment that costs money per file.

ENR-001.notes: Schema-required structured output at both vendors. Also found that repeated Http::fake() for one URL does not replace the first stub.

ENR-002.notes: First real AI task. Suggestions are always PROPOSED. Automatic enrichment OFF by default. No review screen yet.

ENR-003.notes: Call ceilings and a ledger-derived circuit breaker. Counts calls, never money. Transcription spend is NOT covered.

ENR-004.notes: Accept / edit-before-accept / reject / regenerate through SetTrackMetadata. Found that the audit scrubber silently drops list-valued context.

ENR-005.notes: The review screen. Four levels as four server-named objects. Refusal codes are not translated on the screen yet and there is no bulk action.

EDI-001.notes: EditorialProfile: an imprint is a row, not code. No caller yet.

PROD-002.notes: ProductionSlot. The scheduler opens rows and never generates. Found a SQLite date-format caveat on the unique key.

PROD-003.notes: Inventory before generation. NO_ATTRIBUTION rather than zero when stock cannot be counted. Two plans on one imprint share stock -- known limitation.

Extrait ValidateReleaseIdentifiers de ValidateDelivery : sans distributeur configuré — le défaut livré — une sortie sans aucun ISRC passait la validation, devenait READY et ne disait rien. 12 tests / 53 assertions ; 9 mutations, 0 survivante.

Avant, un TrackCandidate ne naissait que de ProcessIngestionItem ou de SelectMusicGenerationResult : les octets déposés arrivaient, étaient vérifiés, et s'arrêtaient là. Ajoute le test de parcours de bout en bout. 11 tests / 73 assertions ; 7 mutations, 1 survivante (garde « vérifié seulement » non testé) corrigée puis tuée.

DIST-007.note: Le distributeur recoit le ReleasePackage, jamais l'agregat. ADR-0020.

OBS-002.note: Le docteur signale une file que personne ne traite. L'age du plus vieux job non reserve separe une file occupee d'une file morte ; un compte ne le peut pas.

OBS-003.note: Le docteur signale le travail qui a echoue et que personne n'a regarde. La verification de retard ne peut pas le voir.

DIST-008.note: L'oeuvre traverse avec l'enregistrement : ISWC et credits d'auteurs atteignent le distributeur. ADR-0021.

WRK-003.note: sanitube:worker:check — certifier un vrai worker : poignee de main, vocabulaire de capacites, refus de ce qu'il n'annonce pas, jeton applique. Le stockage avait son equivalent, le worker non.

OBS-004.note: Une capacite degradee atteint le docteur. Il ne rapportait que l'indisponible-et-requis, donc chaque etat degrade — stockage sans URL expirante, mailer qui ne livre rien — n'etait dit qu'a sanitube:health.

PERF-005.note: Les cinq ecrans que le test d'echelle ne pouvait pas atteindre sont mesures : enrichissement, distribution, production, generations, projets. La liste des ecrans est desormais lue dans le routeur au lieu d'etre tenue a la main — un ecran nouveau echoue par son nom tant qu'il n'est pas mesure, differe avec sa raison, ou declare comme n'ayant pas de lignes qui croissent avec le catalogue.

DEP-007.note: sanitube:host — lire la machine, jamais la supposer. Inspection par lectures de fichiers et recherches PATH uniquement, aucun processus execute. Cinq profils d'installation ; le conseiller ne suggere que les trois detectables et nomme les deux qui sont des choix. La preuve cPanel l'emporte sur tout ce qu'un VPS aurait.

DEP-008.note: Le journal d'installation : chaque etape des deux installeurs (shell et web) est enregistree dans storage/installer/journal.json, 0600, details passes par la regle de censure partagee. --status le lit ; --profile enregistre la forme choisie et le message final parle sa langue. Le journal enregistre et n'autorise jamais ; un journal corrompu est preserve a cote, pas remplace.

DEP-009.note: Installation sans surveillance depuis un fichier de configuration protege. Dialecte .env, liste blanche egale a celle de l'installeur web (tenue par un test par reflexion) ; un fichier lisible au-dela de son proprietaire est refuse avant d'en lire un octet ; une cle inconnue arrete l'execution par son nom ; le mot de passe du proprietaire vient du fichier ou de SANITUBE_OWNER_PASSWORD, jamais d'argv.

DEP-010.note: sanitube:provision — ligne cron, unites systemd et bloc nginx generes depuis des entrees validees. Une valeur qui pourrait passer une directive est refusee, jamais echappee, et le refus ne cite jamais la valeur. La file est une unite template : la concurrence est le nombre d'instances activees. Nomme par SANITUBE_INSTANCE_NAME. Genere seulement — installer dans /etc, nginx -t et systemd-analyze restent a root.

DEP-011.note: sanitube:frontend:install — le bundle CI atterrit atomiquement, pour son propre commit. Deux renames, jamais un build a moitie servi ; l'archive est hostile jusqu'a preuve d'ennui (traversee, absolus, symlinks refuses, chemin jamais cite) ; --sha verifie contre HEAD lu de .git en fichiers ; la commande ne telecharge rien, deliberement.

DEP-012.note: bin/update.sh + verrou de deploiement. La revision est un argument obligatoire sans defaut ; arbre sale refuse ; sauvegarde avant le rideau ; maintenance relachee par trap ; le docteur a le dernier mot une fois le site remonte. sanitube:deploy prend un verrou fichier — refus avec l'age du detenteur, perime apres une heure, relache meme quand une etape echoue. Le 'x' O_EXCL est nomme comme non tenu par les tests : la course est le point.

DEP-013.note: sanitube:providers — un modele de certification, six etats, aucun booleen vague. CERTIFIED ne se gagne que par les commandes qui parlent aux vrais services, enregistre dans un registre empreinte sur la configuration exacte : changer de bucket ou d'adresse de-certifie en silence. La suite de tests lie le registre ailleurs — la reussite d'un test ne peut jamais se lire comme une vraie certification.

DEP-014.note: sanitube:smoke — du vrai HTTP contre l'installation deployee. GET seul, jamais authentifie, delais bornes. Un tableau de bord non authentifie qui repond 200 est traite comme l'incendie qu'il est ; /.env servi echoue quelle que soit la ligne de statut ; l'actif hache nomme par le manifest doit se servir. bin/update.sh l'execute une fois le site remonte.

DEP-015.note: Le fil a une version, distincte de celle de l'application. Un desaccord connu refuse les travaux avant tout envoi ; une annonce absente vaut version 1 par definition, donc chaque worker qui marchait hier marche encore. worker:check nomme les deux numeros. sanitube:worker:token frappe une fois vers le terminal et ne retient rien ; le port nginx devient une entree.

DEP-016.note: bin/bootstrap.sh — la detection avant l'action, rien pipe dans un shell, l'installeur Composer verifie SHA-384. L'hygiene des scripts est un garde-fou decouvert, pas une liste. La detection est prouvee en CI sur Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 et AlmaLinux 9 — etroit expres : la convergence complete est l'etape de certification sur vrai VPS. Index docs/deployment/README.md.

DEP-017.note: La sauvegarde nocturne est planifiee (SANITUBE_BACKUP_AT, vide desactive), la fraicheur jugee a part. Les seuils disque atteignent le docteur — volumes application et sauvegarde juges separement, en megaoctets absolus, le bloqueur arrete un deploiement. sanitube:self-test : un chef d'orchestre, aucune duplication. Le plan de certification reel A-K est ecrit et executable sans edition de code.

DEP-018.note: sanitube:assets:relocate — le catalogue demenage sous preuve. ADR-0022 : l'emplacement peut bouger sous preuve, l'identite jamais. Copie en flux, verification de la cible contre ce que l'actif a toujours affirme, puis sauvegarde sanctionnee que l'observateur consomme. Un changement de disque nu jette toujours ; une sauvegarde mixte refusee depense aussi la sanction (son test a attrape la premiere version). Aucune source jamais supprimee — le service n'a pas d'appel delete a faire contre une source, par conception.

DEP-019.note: sanitube:mail:certify — configure et livre sont deux faits differents. Un seul vrai message, a une adresse que l'operateur nomme, seulement quand il le demande. L'acceptation devient un enregistrement du registre, empreinte sur la configuration du mailer ; changer de relais de-certifie en silence. Les mots du transport ne sont pas cites — ils portent des hotes et parfois des identifiants.

DEP-020.note: Independance multi-instances et faits GPU. Le prefixe de cache se cle sur SANITUBE_INSTANCE_NAME ; l'inspection lit le marqueur noyau NVIDIA (pas le binaire qu'un paquet laisse) et le conseil du profil worker l'enonce dans les deux sens sans jamais bloquer. Pare-feu/SSH, rotation des logs, desinstallation et stockage-objet-n'est-pas-une-sauvegarde documentes comme actes d'operateur.

UPL-004.note: Le vrai MP3 refuse en production. L'ecran d'import promettait le plafond configure (2 Go) alors qu'un depot relaye meurt a post_max_size ; la regle qui reconcilie les deux n'existait que sur l'ecran d'upload unitaire. Elle vit desormais dans UploadAdmission et les deux ecrans la lisent. Un corps que PHP a jete repond HOST_UPLOAD_LIMIT (413) avec le nombre, au lieu de « le champ fichier est obligatoire ». Le docteur signale le desaccord avant qu'une personne ne le rencontre.

CFG-001.note: Le worker et le courrier rejoignent le centre de configuration. POST /settings/test execute les memes sondes que les commandes et enregistre une vraie certification ; la cible est un vocabulaire ferme (enum ConnectionProbe, une seule copie lue par le modele de lecture, la requete et le controleur). Les details sont censures en sortie : une lecture signee en echec cite sa propre URL signee. Le bouton existe a l'ecran.

CFG-002.note: Administration des fournisseurs. acestep etait resoluble et non declare : le seul vrai moteur de generation ne pouvait pas etre choisi. La selection devient inscriptible pour la generation, l'IA et la distribution, contrainte par in: sur les memes noms que l'ecran propose (SelectableProviders). Les identifiants IA suivent le fournisseur selectionne. Le test de parite passe d'une union a une egalite configuration par configuration, dans les deux sens. Le studio dit ou configurer ce qu'il declare non configure.

CFG-003.note: Le courrier et les etats de certification quittent la console. CertifyMail est extrait de la commande : une seule implementation. Le destinataire est l'adresse de l'operateur connecte et ne peut jamais venir de la requete. Un refus est FAILED sans repeter ce que le transport a dit, et n'enregistre rien. Les neuf etats de ProviderStandings sont publies sur l'ecran de reglages, identiques a ce que sanitube:providers rapporte.

CFG-004.note: Cinq sections manquantes : audio/media, file, sauvegarde, automatisation, systeme/sante. Les chemins d'executables et la connexion de file sont publies et jamais inscriptibles, chacun nomme avec sa raison. La destination de sauvegarde est refusee a l'endroit ou l'erreur est commise. Les refus de validation s'affichent sur le champ concerne.

TRASH-001.note: Un actif mis a la corbeille pouvait devenir le master d'un titre et partir dans un package. La garde vit sur le modele Track ; BuildDeliveryPackage refuse aussi, en defense en profondeur. Les deux tests ont d'abord echoue.
TRASH-001.found_by: audit interne de la revue des doublons et de la corbeille

UPL-005.note: app.blade.php ne publiait aucune meta csrf-token. Import.vue, Upload.vue et Settings/Index.vue batissent leurs requetes a la main (progression, annulation) et la lisaient : en-tete vide, 419 avant tout controleur, aucun octet arrive, rien dans laravel.log parce qu'une 419 est rendue et non rapportee. readCode ne lisait que la cle code, absente d'une 419, donc tout devenait DEPOSIT_FAILED. Correctif en deux parties : la balise, et un utilitaire partage resources/js/Support/request.ts qui lit un refus en tenant compte du statut (419 SESSION_EXPIRED, 413 HOST_UPLOAD_LIMIT, 401 NOT_SIGNED_IN, 403 NOT_PERMITTED, 5xx SERVER_ERROR ; un code nomme par le serveur gagne toujours). Six langues. Aucun assouplissement de CSRF : le test cle rejoue le depot avec le middleware ACTIF.
UPL-005.gap_closed: Le contrat entre le gabarit Blade et le JavaScript qui le lit n'etait couvert par rien : les tests de fonctionnalite passent par le client de test ou VerifyCsrfToken ne s'applique pas, et Vitest simule le reseau.

USR-001.note: Les comptes s'administrent depuis le produit. sanitube:user:create etait le seul moyen de creer un compte, et role/is_active n'avaient aucun chemin d'ecriture : une installation se montait en SSH et ne se dotait jamais d'une equipe depuis l'interieur. /users cree, promeut, retrograde, desactive et reactive, chaque changement audite avec la personne qui a demande. La suppression n'est pas offerte : audit_events.actor_id est restrictOnDelete, un bouton supprimer ne marcherait que pour les comptes sans histoire et echouerait exactement pour les gens qu'on veut voir partir.
USR-001.ownership_note: OWNER est la racine. La regle du dernier OWNER etait ecrite dans un docblock et appliquee nulle part. Deux gardes la rendent inatteignable en une seule requete ; le compte derriere elles est pris sous lockForUpdate pour le cas qu'elles ne couvrent pas, deux OWNER qui se retirent mutuellement en meme temps. Un OWNER desactive n'est pas compte. Les secrets et identifiants fournisseur sont refuses a l'ADMIN a l'ecriture, jamais a la lecture de l'etat configure/non configure.
USR-001.mutation_note: 18 mutants cibles, 18 tues. Six avaient d'abord survecu : les tests de la racine de propriete atteignaient une garde anterieure (OWNER_ONLY, NOT_YOURSELF) et n'exercaient jamais le compte. Reecrits sur le chemin que la regle protege reellement, deux requetes concurrentes avec l'acteur charge tel que sa propre requete l'a lu.

notes.portability: $table->json() is forbidden platform-wide. MariaDB's json is an alias for longtext/utf8mb4_bin while MySQL 8's is a native binary type, so one migration yields two types with two comparison semantics. Use ->longText() with an Eloquent array cast. Enforced by PortabilityTest::no_engine_specific_construct_is_used_in_any_migration.
notes.capabilities: FFmpeg is a capability, never a dependency. SANITUBE_MEDIA_ANALYSIS_REQUIRED defaults to false so a cPanel host without ffprobe still produces promotable candidates.
notes.catalogue_writes: Promotion is the only v1 write that creates a Track. It always creates it DRAFT, mints no ISRC, and is refusable for six reasons each carrying a machine-readable code. One-master-one-track is enforced in PromoteTrackCandidate rather than by a unique index, because tracks is ARCH-002's validated schema.
notes.ci_triggers: The workflow only built pull requests whose base was main, so a PR stacked on another claude/** branch showed zero checks — indistinguishable from a repo with no CI. The pull_request branch filter now includes 'claude/**'. Fixed on the CAT-001 branch; it reaches main when that branch merges.
notes.migration_rollback: MySQL and MariaDB drop the index they generate for a foreign key once a user-created index can serve it. A migration that adds a unique index on an FK column must therefore drop the foreign key before dropping that index in down(), then restore it. SQLite enforces none of this, so a local rollback check on SQLite proves nothing about the server engines. Enforced by PortabilityTest::an_index_added_over_a_foreign_key_column_is_undone_in_the_right_order.
notes.ai_disabled_provider: The disabled AI provider is named 'none', never 'null'. Laravel's Env::get() turns the literal string null in a .env file into PHP null, so SANITUBE_AI_PROVIDER=null yields an empty provider name and the env() default never applies. Empty/absent/null configuration normalises to 'none' at AiManager::normaliseProviderName(); an unknown non-empty name is an error.
notes.no_hosts_in_php: PortabilityTest rejects any absolute http(s) host in PHP, config included. Vendor endpoints come from the environment with no PHP default; .env.example ships the public URLs.
notes.generation: Generation never creates a Track: a selected result becomes a VERIFIED asset and a TrackCandidate with source GENERATED, which CAT-001 reviews. commercial_rights_status defaults UNKNOWN and is never inferred from a successful generation. Polling is bounded twice — the job re-dispatches only while pollable, and the service fails the generation at max_polls.
notes.release_mutation: ReleaseMutationPolicy is the single place that says which edits a status permits. DRAFT allows everything; READY allows nothing structural but can be reopened to DRAFT; SUBMITTED/DELIVERED/LIVE/TAKEN_DOWN allow nothing and cannot be reopened. I4 is called, never reimplemented or relaxed.
notes.track_numbering: release_tracks carries UNIQUE(release_id, disc_number, track_number). Renumbering must be two-phase — park every row above the occupied range, then write final numbers — because a row-by-row update collides the moment a track moves into a slot another has not yet left.
notes.distribution: Submission is the one irreversible act. Three guards against a duplicate delivery: UNIQUE(release_id, provider), a guarded status UPDATE, and a derived (not random) idempotency key sha256(release uuid|distributor). Outage != rejection: unreachable and unconfigured both produce validation errors, an outage during submit leaves the delivery FAILED and retryable. DIST-001 never mints an ISRC or UPC — a missing one is a validation error.
notes.identity: Session auth on Laravel's users table. Three roles (OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER). role and is_active are NOT mass-assignable — set them with forceFill. Wrong password, unknown email and deactivated account answer identically to prevent account enumeration. Throttling is per email AND per IP. No self-registration: accounts come from sanitube:user:create.
notes.translation_gate: tests/Feature/Localization walks EVERY file in lang/en and checks all configured locales both directions. Any new UI string needs en/fr/es/it/pt/de or CI fails.
notes.design_system: Semantic tokens only (--color-surface, never --color-zinc-900). Status colour is decided in StatusBadge alone; labels always come from translations. Navigation is built server-side and unbuilt sections show as disabled — 'available' is presentation, never authorisation. MetricCard takes number|null and renders null as an em dash, never 0.
notes.frontend_toolchain: @vitejs/plugin-vue@5 peers Vite ^5||^6; the project is on Vite 7. Resolved with plugin-vue@6 (which supports Vite 7), NOT --force or --legacy-peer-deps: a peer conflict is compatibility information, and overriding it keeps the incompatibility. Same for vue-tsc@3. npm run types runs in CI.

asset_preview_url.status: arbitrated by review, binding for UI-003b
asset_preview_url.rule: No signed URL is ever included in the Asset detail payload at page load.
asset_preview_url.why: A signed URL is a temporary bearer credential. Minting one on every detail view needlessly widens its lifetime and its exposure surface.
asset_preview_url.flow: Asset detail -> user clicks Preview -> authorised UI action -> backend verifies permission and asset kind/status -> mints short-lived signed URL -> browser receives it
constraints: never disk, path, bucket or credentials
VERIFIED required for an audio master
minted on demand, never on the detail GET
URL never persisted in the database
full URL never written to logs
if the provider cannot issue temporary URLs: show Preview unavailable, never make the object public

known_limitations.where: All five catalogue index filter forms
known_limitations.what: A refused filter answers 422 with a JSON body rather than an error rendered inside the form.
known_limitations.why_not_fixed: Refusing loudly is what must not regress; presenting it nicely needs inline error display.
known_limitations.priority_note: Now applies to five lists rather than two, which raises it.

known_limitations.what: Orderings are (natural key, uuid) with no composite index over the pair.
known_limitations.why_not_fixed: Not measurable at target catalogue sizes; a migration belongs in a CAT ticket with a measurement behind it.

known_limitations.what: Re-importing the same reference writes a second asset row and a second stored object, which the checksum then resolves to the first. Nothing reaches the catalogue — no Track, no identifier, and the candidate is DUPLICATE — but re-running a 900-file manifest stores 900 objects twice.
known_limitations.why_not_fixed: The current behaviour is defensible: ING-001 re-reads the source rather than assuming a reference imported yesterday still holds the same bytes today, and an object genuinely can be replaced under its key. Skipping on the ingestion key alone would silently miss that replacement — a data-loss trade in the opposite direction.
known_limitations.pinned_by: two tests in ManifestImportTest pin the current behaviour, so whichever way it is later decided the change is visible

known_limitations.what: sanitube:install is covered by 21 tests against a temporary .env and was smoke-run in the development container, but has never been run on a real cPanel account against a real MySQL database.
known_limitations.why_not_fixed: No such account is available to this project. The stages that would differ are the ones that touch the host: directory permissions, the PHP binary path in the cron line, and the account-prefixed database names.
known_limitations.severity: blocks calling installation production-ready, nothing before then

known_limitations.where: ValidateRelease, Release::readinessProblems(), the release builder screen
known_limitations.what: Validation errors and warnings are English sentences, not codes, so they render untranslated on the five non-English locales while the rest of the screen is translated.
known_limitations.why_not_fixed: The same strings are imploded into delivery-attempt records and matched on by SubmitDelivery::wasUnreachable(). Turning them into codes changes delivery semantics, which is a domain ticket (REL-002), not something a UI ticket does quietly.

known_limitations.what: The preflight’s errors and warnings are the same untranslated domain sentences the release builder shows.
known_limitations.why_not_fixed: ValidateDelivery merges ValidateRelease’s output with its own and SubmitDelivery::wasUnreachable() matches on the text. Same root cause, same ticket.

bulk_001_scope.finding: BULK-001 is much smaller than its ticket assumes. ING-001 already provides batches, per-item state, idempotent retry via UNIQUE(ingestion_key, active_marker), attempt_count, per-item failure codes, CompletedWithErrors as a first-class outcome, the processing and finalising jobs, StartIngestionBatch::handle() taking a prefix or explicit references, and CloudImportReader.
bulk_001_scope.instruction: DO NOT create a BulkImportBatch table or any parallel import path. Two mechanisms both claiming to prevent duplicate imports is worse than one — the second is the one nobody tests against a real retry.

preflight_vs_history.severity: would have refused every first install
preflight_vs_history.finding: The scheduler capability reports unavailable until a cron entry has fired at least once. Preflight blocking on it meant a first install could never pass, because the condition cannot be true before the installation exists.
preflight_vs_history.instruction: A preflight check asks whether the machine CAN run SaniTube. A health check asks whether this installation IS running. The same detectors serve both, but a capability describing the installation's history is not a prerequisite. InstallationService::NOT_PREREQUISITES names the two exclusions with their reasons; keep the list short, because a preflight that skips checks stops meaning anything.

guard_covered_at_only_one_level.severity: a defective test that read as a passing one
guard_covered_at_only_one_level.finding: The mutation removing the overwrite guard from EnvironmentFile::createFromExample() stayed green, because InstallationService checks exists() before ever calling it. The service-level test covered the behaviour; nothing covered the guard.
guard_covered_at_only_one_level.instruction: When two layers both guard the same thing, the mutation must be run against the inner one. INS-002's web installer reaches EnvironmentFile without the service's outer check, so the inner guard is the one that will matter. A direct test now covers it.

scope_correction_v1.statement: SaniTube is a music catalogue and distribution platform. It is NOT a financial platform.
scope_correction_v1.still_in_scope: Rights and credit information strictly necessary for distribution, as catalogue metadata only: author, composer, publisher (as metadata), copyright, the P and C notices, declarative master ownership, contributor roles, ISRC, UPC/EAN, territories, explicit content, language, credits. None of it may trigger a financial calculation.
scope_correction_v1.existing_code: Not deleted. No Revenue/Royalty/Payout/Ledger module was ever built, so nothing has to be removed; the tickets are reclassified instead.
scope_correction_v1.multi_distributor: The domain must contain no logic specific to TuneCore, Too Lost, DistroKid, CD Baby or Ditto. Provider specifics live in adapters. No TuneCore API is assumed to exist, and scraping is never an API substitute.
scope_correction_v1.navigation: `publishing` and `royalties` removed from the sidebar in DIST-UI-001, with their translation keys and icons. Both were placeholders for financial administration. `rights` stays, unavailable: credit and ownership metadata is required for distribution and is not a right to money.
